compat: Plugin minimum: vfox {min_version}. Use current vfox for the commands in this guide.
install_title: A few commands. Then you’re in.
install_description: Check the platform requirements, then choose your version manager. The examples pin a version; search to find other available releases.
copy_error: Select the command and copy it manually
guide_title: From the first install to your daily run.
guide_project_title: Keep the version with the project
guide_project_text: Initialize vfox in Bash and select the project version. With mise, use mise use to select a version for the current project.
faq1_question: How do I find other versions?
faq4_question: How do I update the plugin?
closing_text: Find the source, report an issue or explore the releases on GitHub.
footer_text: An independent vfox plugin documentation site.
hero_line2: With its shell, ready to go.
hero_description: Manage MongoDB Server with vfox or mise. The plugin selects release packages for your system and installs mongosh alongside the server.
feature1_text: Modern MongoDB server packages no longer bundle the legacy mongo shell. The plugin supplies mongosh.
feature2_text: Set MONGOSH_VERSION to choose a shell version, or resolve the latest maintained version during installation.
feature3_text: Scheduled repository jobs maintain version lists, resolved through jsDelivr during installation.
linux_deps: The plugin chooses packages by Linux distribution and CPU architecture. Runtime libraries and system requirements depend on the MongoDB version.
macos_deps: Uses upstream packages matching macOS and CPU architecture. Check that the selected version supports your system.
windows_deps: Uses upstream Windows release packages. Run mongod and mongosh from PowerShell after installation.
guide_tools_text: Installation does not start the database. Check versions first, then configure data directories and services using MongoDB documentation.
guide3_text: Set MONGOSH_VERSION before installing MongoDB. This controls the shell version without changing the selected server version.
guide3_detail: This example pins MongoDB 8.0.6 and mongosh 2.8.3.
guide3_note: Server and shell version lists are maintained separately under assets/ in the repository.
faq2_answer: MongoDB 6.0+ no longer bundles the legacy mongo shell. The plugin separately installs mongosh as an interactive client.
faq3_question: Does version search call the live GitHub API?
faq3_answer: Version lookup reads repository-maintained lists distributed through jsDelivr. Software packages are still downloaded from upstream release locations.
description: Manage MongoDB Server with vfox or mise. The plugin selects release packages for your system and installs mongosh alongside the server.
faq1_answer: Run vfox search mongo or mise ls-remote vfox:yeshan333/vfox-mongo to find available versions.
faq4_answer: Run vfox update mongo. The plugin checks the manifest published in this repository.
